_comment: Reviewed, optimized PUBLIC marketing assets available to the website.
Empty 'assets' means no Higgsfield generation has been run or approved yet;
the public site falls back to its built-in procedural (CSS/SVG/canvas) visuals.
Every entry is public marketing media and is never derived from patient data.
